carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single dominant horizontal linear feature visible along the upper flank with a distinct highlight-to-shadow vertical gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized disruption of the dermal pattern and a potential indentation on the mid-flank at the coordinate indicated by the overlaid arrow.
other_distinctive_markers: Synthetic white arrow graphic overlaid on the image pointing toward a specific region on the mid-lower flank.
